judgments.reason: Dataset DOI and authors (Grosse-Wentrup, Liefhold, Gramann, Buss) match this TBME 2008 paper, which reports the two-class motor-imagery EEG experiment that produced this data.
MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS; it is not a paper describing the Munich Motor Imagery dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
